entries.answer: Join Eddie-Guest. The password is stay-with-eddie, all lower case with dashes.
The front door has a keypad. Your code is in your booking message, and the door locks itself after thirty seconds.
Checkout is at 11 AM. Start the dishwasher, take the trash out, and just close the door behind you.
The thermostat is in the hallway. Tap the arrows to set the temperature; 68 to 72 is comfortable. Please don't go above 75.
Press the home button on the black remote. Netflix, YouTube and Prime are already signed in on the Fire TV.
Pods are in the drawer under the machine. Fill the tank at the back, pop a pod in and press the big button. Tea and the kettle are next to it.
Pods are under the sink. Press Normal, then Start; it takes about two hours.
The washer and dryer are in the closet off the kitchen. Detergent is on the shelf above. Use Quick Wash, then Normal Dry.
Trash goes in the gray bin and recycling in the blue one, both beside the garage. Pickup is Tuesday morning.
Turn the shower handle all the way left and give it about thirty seconds to warm up.
Fresh towels and sheets are in the hall closet next to the bathroom. Extra blankets are in the bedroom chest.
Park in the driveway, on the left side. Street parking is fine after 6 PM.
Quiet hours are 10 PM to 8 AM. No smoking indoors and no parties, please.
There's a café and a grocery store two blocks east, and the pharmacy is next to the grocery store. Your host's favorite dinner spot is the noodle place on the corner.
For an emergency, call 911. The first aid kit is under the bathroom sink, the fire extinguisher is beside the fridge, and the fuse box is in the garage.

I only listen after you say Hey Eddie. Your voice is handled on this box, never sent to the cloud, and I don't keep recordings or transcripts. Guest mode also keeps the household's network history private.
Demo owner-only note: the alarm panel is by the garage door. Guests never hear this entry.
Demo owner-only note: the spare key is with the neighbor. Guests never hear this entry.
